sentences.text:
THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 22.11.2018, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl.MC.No. 7874 of 2018 2  ORDER
The petitioner was the first accused in C.C.No. 2493 of 2016 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kodungalloor.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kodungalloor
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He along with the co-accused allegedly committed certain offences under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

This court by Annexure III order quashed the proceedings against the co-accused on the ground that the Director of Food Regulatory Complaints Division directed all States and Union Territories not to launch prosecutions for non-conformance of limit of iron filings in cases where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19/05/2016.
They were also advised to withdraw all such prosecutions launched prior to 19/05/2016.
The proceedings against the petitioner are now pending as C.C.No. 787 of 2018.
The prayer is to quash the proceedings as against him also.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
3. I have perused Annexure III order of this court in Crl.M.C.No.3248 of 2017 by which the proceedings against the co-accused were quashed.
The same reason is applicable to the petitioner also.
The proceedings against him are also liable to be quashed.
In the result, this Crl.M.C. is allowed.
The proceedings in C.C.No. 787 of 2018 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kodungalloor are quashed.
